register.description: Reset control for Command FIFO and flush control for MAU Core. This register is not self-clearing.

bitfield.description: pkeFlush input to PKE(active high). When set, this bit will assert the mauFlush input to MAU Core, resets command FIFO, issues reset to MCG. Flush sequence will complete some cycles after this bit is cleared. PKE will remain in flush state as long as this bit is asserted.

register.description: Interrupt Status Register. Writing a 1 to any bit in this register clears the associated interrupt. Cleared on pkeFlush.

bitfield.description: Asserted when SRAM initialization (when enabled) or FLUSH sequence after reset are completed. The PKE core will go into IDLE state when SRAM initialization (when enabled) and FLUSH sequence after resset finish.
Asserted when MCG status indicates ERROR/PANIC. This interrupt is re-asserted when cleared if MCG status is MCG_ERROR/PANIC in PKE_STATUS register
This interrupt is re-asserted when cleared if MAU Core Status is ERROR/PANIC in PKE_STATUS register.
This interrupt is asserted when FIFO transitions to empty.
This interrupt is re-asserted when cleared if FIFO Write Error is asserted in PKE_STATUS register.
This interrupt is asserted when MAU status transition from BUSY to READY/ERROR/PANIC.
